artists.biography:
Formed by Devin Townsend to draw a firmer line between Strapping Young Lad and his solo material.
Not to be confused with Townsend’s other musical outfit Devin Townsend Project
In 2007 Devin split up both this band and Strapping Young Lad.

Devin Garret Townsend (born May 5, 1972) is a Canadian musician, songwriter and record producer. He was the founder, songwriter, vocalist, and guitarist in extreme metal band Strapping Young Lad from 1994 to 2007 and has had an extensive career as a solo artist.

    Devin Townsend – vocals, guitars, keyboards
    Brian 'Beav' Waddell – guitars
    Mike Young – bass
    Dave Young – keyboards
    Ryan Van Poederooyen – drums

perplexity.description:
Synchestra is the second and final studio album by The Devin Townsend Band, released in 2006 on HevyDevy Records in North America and InsideOut in Europe. Musically, the album blends progressive rock with electronic elements, showcasing Devin Townsend’s signature style of combining melodic accessibility with experimental textures. The record features seamless transitions between tracks, ranging from gentle acoustic passages and psychedelic pop to energetic polka-infused metal, all underpinned by lush keyboards and Townsend’s dynamic vocal delivery. This eclectic mix reflects his ability to merge disparate influences into a cohesive and original sound.

Within Devin Townsend’s discography, Synchestra stands as a pivotal work, representing the culmination of his vision for a stable band format after years of solo projects and shifting lineups. It follows the band’s debut, Accelerated Evolution (2003), and further refines the balance between songwriting clarity and sonic experimentation. The album was well-received by critics for its creativity and emotional range, with praise for its originality and production quality. While not a mainstream commercial breakthrough, Synchestra solidified Townsend’s reputation as a leading figure in progressive rock and electronic-influenced metal.
